subject.title: [Bug]: Web UI chat images display too large

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open fork PR that applies the sidebar image sizing parity fix for this issue?
rationale: Current main still has the source-visible CSS mismatch, but the open linked fix candidate is an external fork PR with maintainerCanModify false, so cleanup automation should not close the issue before a maintainer chooses the path.

options.title: Adopt or replace the CSS parity fix
options.body: Create or land a maintainer-controlled version of the sidebar image sizing change with browser proof.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Keep the issue open while asking the fork PR author for fresh proof and an updated branch.

options.title: Reject the parity fix
options.body: Keep the issue open only if maintainers decide the oversized image symptom needs a different proven root-cause fix.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the CSS parity fix
recommendation.body: Create or land a maintainer-controlled version of the sidebar image sizing change with browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev introduced the relevant image sizing rules and has the clearest current history connection to the UI styling decision.
